Outdoor Saunas

Most outdoor saunas are barrels or cabins listing for about $4,500 to $9,000 before wiring and a base. Barrels heat a smaller volume and assemble fastest. Cabins and cubes give more headroom and room for more people. Check whether the heater is included, the electrical spec and the wood before you buy.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
